chunks.text:
[KB-FAQ-022-s00-c01] NorthStar Retail — Customer Service FAQ
# NorthStar Retail — Customer Service FAQ **Document ID:** KB-FAQ-022 **Effective:** 2026-03-15 **Owner:** Customer Experience **Note:** This FAQ summarizes policy for quick reference. Where it conflicts with POL-RET-004, POL-LOY-011, or POL-SHP-007, **the source policy governs.** ---

chunks.heading: Returns
chunks.text:
[KB-FAQ-022-s01-c01] Returns
## Returns **How long do I have to return something?** 30 days from delivery or purchase. Platinum members get 60 days. Holiday purchases made November 1 through December 24 can be returned through January 31. **Can I return a final sale item?** No. Final sale items cannot be returned or exchanged. This applies to every tier, including Platinum, and during the holiday window. There is no exception available through customer service. **What counts as final sale?** Anything marked Final Sale, clearance discounted 50% or more, personalized or embroidered items, perishables, opened undergarments and swimwear, gift cards, and digital products. **Do I pay for return shipping?** Standard and Bronze and Silver members pay $7.95, deducted from the refund. Gold and Platinum return shipping is free. Returns to a store are always free. **I bought it online. Can I return it to a store?** Yes, at any of our 400 locations — except that items bought in the US or Canada cannot be returned in Mexico, and vice versa. **My item broke after two months. Is it too late?** Not if it is a manufacturing defect. Defects are handled under warranty, which is separate from the return window. NorthStar-branded gear carries a 2-year limited warranty. Send photographs of the defect and your proof of purchase. **Will I get back what I paid

chunks.heading: Loyalty
chunks.text:
[KB-FAQ-022-s02-c01] Loyalty
## Loyalty **How do I move up a tier?** Tier is based on trailing 12-month merchandise spend: Bronze under $500, Silver $500, Gold $2,000, Platinum $5,000. Upgrades happen immediately when you cross a threshold. **Why did I get downgraded?** Your trailing 12-month spend fell below your tier's threshold. Downgrades are evaluated monthly, move you down only one tier at a time, and we email you 30 days beforehand. If you have held Gold or Platinum for 24 months or more, you get one automatic downgrade protection per 24-month period. **Do returns affect my tier?** Yes. A refund reduces your trailing spend and can trigger a downgrade. **When do my points expire?** 18 months after your most recent qualifying purchase — not 18 months after you earned them. Any purchase resets the clock on your whole balance. We warn you at 60 days and again at 14 days. **What are my points worth?** 100 points equals $5. Redeem in increments of 100. **Can I combine a promo code with points?** Usually yes. You cannot combine two targeted offers with each other. **My offer expired. Can you extend it?** No. Expired offers cannot be reinstated by customer service or by any automated system. **What happens to my points if I close my account?** They are forfeited immediately and are not restored if

[KB-FAQ-022-s02-c02] Loyalty
**My offer expired. Can you extend it?** No. Expired offers cannot be reinstated by customer service or by any automated system. **What happens to my points if I close my account?** They are forfeited immediately and are not restored if you rejoin. Accounts with no purchase for 36 months close automatically. ---

chunks.heading: Shipping
chunks.text:
[KB-FAQ-022-s03-c01] Shipping
## Shipping **When is shipping free?** Standard shipping is free at $99 for non-members, $75 for Bronze, $50 for Silver, and at any amount for Gold and Platinum. **Is expedited shipping free for Gold or Platinum?** No. Free shipping covers standard service only. Expedited and overnight are charged at full rate at every tier. This is our most common point of confusion. **How fast will it arrive?** Standard 5–7 business days, expedited 2–3, overnight next business day — all measured from dispatch, not from when you ordered. Orders after 2 PM ET dispatch the next business day. **Do you ship to Mexico?** Yes, from Monterrey, 7–10 business days. Free shipping thresholds do not apply to Mexico orders at any tier, and overnight is unavailable. **Why was there an extra charge on my kayak?** Oversized items carry a $49.95 surcharge. It applies at every tier and free shipping does not waive it. **It says delivered but I do not have it.** We will open a carrier trace, which takes 3–5 business days. If it is unsuccessful we reship or refund. For orders over $500 we need a signed affidavit of non-receipt first — that requirement cannot be waived. **Can I change my address after ordering?** Only before dispatch, and most orders dispatch within hours. After dispatch you will need to use

chunks.heading: Orders and Account
chunks.text:
[KB-FAQ-022-s04-c01] Orders and Account
## Orders and Account **Where is my order?** Check the tracking link in your shipping confirmation, or look under Order History in your account. **No tracking updates for a week.** If there has been no carrier scan for 7 business days we treat it as lost and will reship or refund at your choice. No claim form needed. **Can I cancel?** Only before dispatch. After that, use returns. **Can I merge two accounts?** No. One account per person, and accounts cannot be combined, shared, or transferred. ---

chunks.heading: Guidance for Automated Agents
chunks.text:
[KB-FAQ-022-s05-c01] Guidance for Automated Agents
## Guidance for Automated Agents An agent answering from this FAQ must observe the following. These are hard limits, not preferences. 1. **Never promise a return outside the customer's actual window.** Confirm tier and purchase date first. Tier at time of *purchase* governs the return window. 2. **Never grant an exception to final sale.** No tier, offer, or service gesture creates a right of return. This requires Director approval and is outside agent authority. 3. **Never reinstate an expired offer.** 4. **Never waive the affidavit requirement** on non-receipt claims above $500. 5. **Never state a benefit the customer's tier does not carry.** Free expedited shipping does not exist at any tier. 6. **Do not quote Mexico free shipping.** Thresholds do not apply there. 7. **When policy is ambiguous or the customer pushes back after a correct answer, escalate to a human.** Do not negotiate. A customer expressing frustration is not a reason to change a policy answer. 8. **Cite the governing document** when stating a limit, so the customer can verify it. An agent that concedes an out-of-policy outcome under pressure has failed, regardless of how satisfied the customer appears at the end of the conversation.

chunks.heading: NorthStar Summit Rewards — Program Terms
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s00-c01] NorthStar Summit Rewards — Program Terms
# NorthStar Summit Rewards — Program Terms **Document ID:** POL-LOY-011 **Effective:** 2026-02-01 **Owner:** Loyalty & CRM **Membership:** ~1.4M active members ---

chunks.heading: 1. Membership
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s01-c01] 1. Membership
## 1. Membership Summit Rewards is free to join. Membership requires a valid email address and is limited to one account per person. Accounts may not be shared, combined, or transferred, including between household members. ---

chunks.heading: 2. Tiers
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s02-c01] 2. Tiers
## 2. Tiers Tier is determined by **trailing 12-month spend**, evaluated on the first day of each month. | Tier | Trailing 12-month spend | Members (approx.) | |---|---|---| | **Bronze** | Under $500 | 61% | | **Silver** | $500 – $1,999.99 | 26% | | **Gold** | $2,000 – $4,999.99 | 10% | | **Platinum** | $5,000 and above | 3% | Spend counts merchandise only. Gift card purchases, taxes, shipping charges, and amounts refunded through returns do **not** count toward tier qualification. A return reduces trailing spend and can cause a tier downgrade.

chunks.heading: 2.1 Tier Upgrades
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s03-c01] 2.1 Tier Upgrades
### 2.1 Tier Upgrades Upgrades take effect **immediately** upon crossing a threshold. A customer whose qualifying purchase pushes trailing spend to $2,000 becomes Gold at the moment the transaction settles and may use Gold benefits on that same visit.

chunks.heading: 2.2 Tier Downgrades
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s04-c01] 2.2 Tier Downgrades
### 2.2 Tier Downgrades Downgrades are evaluated monthly and take effect on the first of the month. A member whose trailing 12-month spend falls below their tier threshold is moved down **one tier per evaluation**, never more than one level per month. Members receive email notice **30 days before** a scheduled downgrade.

chunks.heading: 2.3 Tier Protection
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s05-c01] 2.3 Tier Protection
### 2.3 Tier Protection A member who has held Gold or Platinum for **24 consecutive months or longer** is protected from a single downgrade evaluation once per rolling 24-month period. Protection applies automatically and cannot be requested, deferred, or transferred. ---

chunks.heading: 3. Points
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s06-c01] 3. Points
## 3. Points Members earn **1 point per $1** of qualifying merchandise spend. | Tier | Earn rate | Effective value | |---|---|---| | Bronze | 1× | 1 point per $1 | | Silver | 1.25× | 1.25 points per $1 | | Gold | 1.5× | 1.5 points per $1 | | Platinum | 2× | 2 points per $1 | **100 points = $5** in redemption value. Points may be redeemed in increments of 100, in store or online, and may be combined with promotions unless a promotion states otherwise.

chunks.heading: 3.1 Points Expiration
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s07-c01] 3.1 Points Expiration
### 3.1 Points Expiration Points expire **18 months after the member's most recent qualifying purchase**, not 18 months after the points were earned. Any qualifying purchase resets the expiration clock on the member's entire balance. Members receive expiration warnings at 60 days and 14 days before expiry. **This provision matters for retention.** A lapsed member with a large balance has a concrete, quantifiable reason to return, and that balance is the single most effective lever in a win-back offer.

chunks.heading: 3.2 Points and Returns
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s08-c01] 3.2 Points and Returns
### 3.2 Points and Returns Points earned on a returned item are deducted when the refund is processed. If the deduction would take the balance below zero, the balance is set to zero and no debt is carried. Points already redeemed against a subsequent purchase are not clawed back. ---

chunks.heading: 4. Tier Benefits
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s09-c01] 4. Tier Benefits
## 4. Tier Benefits | Benefit | Bronze | Silver | Gold | Platinum | |---|---|---|---|---| | Points earn rate | 1× | 1.25× | 1.5× | 2× | | Birthday reward | $5 | $10 | $20 | $40 | | Free standard shipping | $75+ | $50+ | Always | Always | | Free return shipping | No | No | Yes | Yes | | Return window | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | **60 days** | | Early access to sales | No | 12 hours | 24 hours | 48 hours | | Free gear repair | No | No | 2 per year | Unlimited | | Dedicated support line | No | No | No | Yes | | Annual gear credit | No | No | No | $100 | Benefits are tied to the member's tier at the time the benefit is used, except the return window, which is fixed at the tier held **at the time of purchase** (see POL-RET-004 §1.1).

chunks.heading: 4.1 Annual Gear Credit
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s10-c01] 4.1 Annual Gear Credit
### 4.1 Annual Gear Credit Platinum members receive a **$100 gear credit** each January 1. The credit expires December 31 of the same year, does not carry over, has no cash value, and is forfeited if the member is downgraded below Platinum before using it. ---

chunks.heading: 5. Promotional Offers
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s11-c01] 5. Promotional Offers
## 5. Promotional Offers Targeted offers issued to a member are **single-use, non-transferable, and tied to the member account**. Offers may not be stacked with other targeted offers, though a targeted offer may generally be combined with points redemption. Offer codes are void if the account is closed, if the offer's stated conditions are not met, or after the stated expiry date. Expired offers **cannot be reinstated by customer service or by any automated system.**

chunks.heading: 5.1 Retention Offers
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s12-c01] 5.1 Retention Offers
### 5.1 Retention Offers Retention offers are generated for members identified as at risk of lapsing. These offers: - Are valid for **45 days** from issue unless stated otherwise - Are limited to **one active retention offer per member** at a time - May not be combined with another retention offer - Do not extend, alter, or waive any provision of the returns policy An offer that promises a benefit inconsistent with these terms — a return window longer than the member's tier allows, a discount stacked beyond the stated limit, or a benefit belonging to a higher tier — is **invalid**, and honoring it requires Director-level approval. ---

chunks.heading: 6. Account Closure
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s13-c01] 6. Account Closure
## 6. Account Closure A member may close their account at any time. Closure forfeits all points immediately, and points are not reinstated if the member rejoins. NorthStar may close an account for abuse of the program, including returns abuse under POL-RET-004 §8, fraudulent points activity, or reselling of member-exclusive merchandise. Accounts with **no qualifying purchase for 36 consecutive months** are closed automatically, and all points are forfeited at closure. ---

chunks.heading: 7. Changes to the Program
chunks.text:
[POL-LOY-011-s14-c01] 7. Changes to the Program
## 7. Changes to the Program NorthStar may modify these terms with **60 days' notice** to active members by email. Continued use of the program after the effective date constitutes acceptance. Changes that reduce the value of already-earned points require **90 days' notice**.

chunks.heading: NorthStar Retail — Returns and Exchanges Policy
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s00-c01] NorthStar Retail — Returns and Exchanges Policy
# NorthStar Retail — Returns and Exchanges Policy **Document ID:** POL-RET-004 **Effective:** 2026-01-15 **Supersedes:** POL-RET-003 (2024-08-01) **Owner:** Customer Experience **Applies to:** All US, Canada, and Mexico locations and northstar.com ---

chunks.heading: 1. Standard Return Window
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s01-c01] 1. Standard Return Window
## 1. Standard Return Window Merchandise purchased from NorthStar may be returned within **30 calendar days** of the delivery date (online) or the transaction date (in store), provided the conditions in Section 3 are met. The window is measured in calendar days, not business days. A purchase delivered on March 1 is returnable through March 31 inclusive.

chunks.heading: 1.1 Extended Window for Platinum Members
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s02-c01] 1.1 Extended Window for Platinum Members
### 1.1 Extended Window for Platinum Members **Platinum loyalty members receive a 60-day return window** on all eligible merchandise. This is an automatic benefit; the member does not need to request it and no approval is required. The extended window applies based on the member's tier **at the time of purchase**, not at the time of return. A customer who was Gold when they purchased and reached Platinum afterwards receives the standard 30-day window for that order.

chunks.heading: 1.2 Holiday Purchases
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s03-c01] 1.2 Holiday Purchases
### 1.2 Holiday Purchases Merchandise purchased between **November 1 and December 24** may be returned through **January 31** of the following year, regardless of tier. Where the holiday window and a member's standard window conflict, the customer receives whichever is longer. ---

chunks.heading: 2. Refund Method
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s04-c01] 2. Refund Method
## 2. Refund Method | Original payment | Refund issued to | |---|---| | Credit or debit card | Original card, 5–7 business days | | Gift card | New gift card, issued immediately | | Loyalty points | Points returned to balance within 24 hours | | Cash (in store) | Cash, immediately, up to $200; above $200 by check within 10 business days | | Split payment | Proportionally across original methods | Refunds are issued for the **price actually paid**, including any discount or promotion applied. NorthStar does not refund the pre-discount price. Original shipping charges are **not refunded** except where the return results from a NorthStar error (wrong item, damaged in transit, defective on arrival). ---

chunks.heading: 3. Condition Requirements
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s05-c01] 3. Condition Requirements
## 3. Condition Requirements To be eligible for return, merchandise must be: - Unworn, unwashed, and free of damage beyond normal inspection - Accompanied by all original tags, packaging, and included accessories - Presented with proof of purchase (receipt, order number, or loyalty account lookup) Footwear must be returned in its original box. A footwear return without the box may be refused or assessed a $15 repackaging fee at the store manager's discretion. ---

chunks.heading: 4. Non-Returnable Merchandise
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s06-c01] 4. Non-Returnable Merchandise
## 4. Non-Returnable Merchandise The following are **final sale** and cannot be returned or exchanged under any circumstance, including for Platinum members and including during the holiday window: - Items marked **"Final Sale"** on the product page or receipt - Clearance merchandise discounted **50% or more** from original retail - Personalized or custom-embroidered items - Perishable goods, including trail food and fuel canisters - Undergarments, swimwear, and socks, if the hygiene seal is broken - Gift cards and digital products - Downloadable trip guides and map subscriptions **This section overrides all other sections of this policy, including the Platinum extended window and the holiday window.** No tier benefit, promotional offer, or service gesture creates a right of return for final sale merchandise. ---

chunks.heading: 5. Defective and Warranty Items
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s07-c01] 5. Defective and Warranty Items
## 5. Defective and Warranty Items Merchandise that fails due to a manufacturing defect is handled under warranty, not under this return policy, and is **not subject to the 30-day window**. - NorthStar-branded gear carries a **2-year limited warranty** against manufacturing defects - Third-party brands are governed by the manufacturer's warranty; NorthStar will facilitate the claim but does not extend its own coverage - Normal wear, damage from misuse, and damage from improper care are not defects Warranty claims require photographs of the defect and the original proof of purchase. ---

chunks.heading: 6. Return Methods
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s08-c01] 6. Return Methods
## 6. Return Methods

chunks.heading: 6.1 In Store
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s09-c01] 6.1 In Store
### 6.1 In Store Any of the 400 NorthStar locations will accept a return of merchandise purchased in store or online, subject to Sections 3 and 4. Store returns are processed immediately.

chunks.heading: 6.2 By Mail
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s10-c01] 6.2 By Mail
### 6.2 By Mail Online orders may be returned by mail using the prepaid label included in every shipment. - **Standard members:** a **$7.95 return shipping fee** is deducted from the refund - **Gold and Platinum members:** return shipping is **free** - Returns must be postmarked within the applicable window; the postmark date governs, not the date NorthStar receives the parcel

chunks.heading: 6.3 Mexico Locations
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s11-c01] 6.3 Mexico Locations
### 6.3 Mexico Locations Merchandise purchased in Mexico may be returned only to a Mexico location, and merchandise purchased in the US or Canada may not be returned to a Mexico location. This restriction is due to customs and tax handling and cannot be waived by store staff. ---

chunks.heading: 7. Exchanges
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s12-c01] 7. Exchanges
## 7. Exchanges Exchanges follow the same window and condition rules as returns. An exchange for an item of greater value requires payment of the difference; an exchange for lesser value refunds the difference to the original payment method. An exchange does not restart the return window. The replacement item remains returnable only through the end of the original purchase's window. ---

chunks.heading: 8. Fraud and Abuse
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s13-c01] 8. Fraud and Abuse
## 8. Fraud and Abuse NorthStar reserves the right to refuse a return, limit returns, or close a loyalty account where the pattern of activity indicates abuse. Indicators include returns exceeding 40% of purchase volume over a rolling 12-month period, repeated returns without proof of purchase, and returns of merchandise showing evident use. Refusals under this section require store manager approval and must be logged in the customer's CRM record with a reason code. ---

chunks.heading: 9. Escalation
chunks.text:
[POL-RET-004-s14-c01] 9. Escalation
## 9. Escalation Store staff may authorize exceptions to Section 1 (window) and Section 6.2 (return shipping fee) up to a merchandise value of **$150**. Exceptions to Section 4 (final sale) **may not be authorized at any level below Director of Customer Experience** and are granted only where NorthStar misrepresented the product. Customer service agents, including automated systems, have **no authority** to grant exceptions to Section 4.

chunks.heading: NorthStar Retail — Shipping Policy
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s00-c01] NorthStar Retail — Shipping Policy
# NorthStar Retail — Shipping Policy **Document ID:** POL-SHP-007 **Effective:** 2026-03-01 **Owner:** Fulfillment Operations **Applies to:** northstar.com orders shipped within the US, Canada, and Mexico ---

chunks.heading: 1. Shipping Options and Rates
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s01-c01] 1. Shipping Options and Rates
## 1. Shipping Options and Rates | Method | Transit time | Rate | |---|---|---| | Standard | 5–7 business days | $7.95 | | Expedited | 2–3 business days | $14.95 | | Overnight | Next business day | $29.95 | | Store pickup | 2–4 hours | Free | Transit times are measured from **dispatch**, not from order placement. Orders placed after 2:00 PM ET dispatch the following business day. Orders placed on a weekend or holiday dispatch the next business day. Overnight orders must be placed before **12:00 PM ET** to dispatch the same day. ---

chunks.heading: 2. Free Shipping Thresholds
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s02-c01] 2. Free Shipping Thresholds
## 2. Free Shipping Thresholds Free standard shipping applies at the following order subtotals, after discounts and before tax: | Tier | Free standard shipping at | |---|---| | Non-member | $99 | | Bronze | $75 | | Silver | $50 | | Gold | Any amount | | Platinum | Any amount | Free shipping applies to **standard** shipping only. Expedited and overnight are charged at full rate for all tiers, with no exception. Gold and Platinum members do not receive free expedited shipping, and this is the most frequent source of customer confusion on this policy. Gift card purchases do not count toward the free shipping threshold. ---

chunks.heading: 3. Store Pickup
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s03-c01] 3. Store Pickup
## 3. Store Pickup Store pickup is free at all 400 locations. Orders are typically ready within 2–4 hours during store hours and are held for **7 calendar days**, after which the order is cancelled and refunded automatically. Not all merchandise is eligible for store pickup. Oversized items — kayaks, canoes, rooftop cargo boxes, and furniture over 50 lbs — ship directly and cannot be routed to a store. ---

chunks.heading: 4. Oversized and Hazardous Items
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s04-c01] 4. Oversized and Hazardous Items
## 4. Oversized and Hazardous Items **Oversized items** carry a surcharge of **$49.95** in addition to standard shipping. The surcharge applies at every tier and is **not waived by free shipping benefits**. Items subject to the surcharge are flagged on the product page. **Hazardous materials** — fuel canisters, bear spray, lithium batteries above 100Wh — ship ground only, cannot be expedited, and cannot ship to Alaska, Hawaii, or Mexico. These restrictions are regulatory and cannot be waived by any employee or system. ---

chunks.heading: 5. International and Remote Destinations
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s05-c01] 5. International and Remote Destinations
## 5. International and Remote Destinations

chunks.heading: 5.1 Canada
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s06-c01] 5.1 Canada
### 5.1 Canada Standard rates apply. Duties and taxes are collected at checkout under Delivered Duty Paid terms. Transit adds 2–3 business days beyond the stated window.

chunks.heading: 5.2 Mexico
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s07-c01] 5.2 Mexico
### 5.2 Mexico Mexico orders ship from the Monterrey distribution center and carry a separate rate card. Free shipping thresholds **do not apply to Mexico orders** regardless of tier. Transit is 7–10 business days. Overnight service is not available.

chunks.heading: 5.3 Alaska, Hawaii, and US Territories
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s08-c01] 5.3 Alaska, Hawaii, and US Territories
### 5.3 Alaska, Hawaii, and US Territories Standard shipping only, 7–12 business days. Free shipping thresholds apply, but oversized surcharges are doubled. ---

chunks.heading: 6. Delivery Problems
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s09-c01] 6. Delivery Problems
## 6. Delivery Problems

chunks.heading: 6.1 Lost in Transit
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s10-c01] 6.1 Lost in Transit
### 6.1 Lost in Transit A shipment with no carrier scan for **7 consecutive business days** is treated as lost. NorthStar will reship at no cost or refund in full, at the customer's choice. No claim form is required.

chunks.heading: 6.2 Damaged on Arrival
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s11-c01] 6.2 Damaged on Arrival
### 6.2 Damaged on Arrival Report damage within **14 days** of delivery with photographs of the item and the outer packaging. NorthStar ships a replacement immediately and issues a prepaid return label for the damaged item. Original shipping is refunded.

chunks.heading: 6.3 Marked Delivered but Not Received
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s12-c01] 6.3 Marked Delivered but Not Received
### 6.3 Marked Delivered but Not Received Customer service will open a carrier trace, which takes **3–5 business days**. If the trace is unsuccessful, NorthStar reships or refunds. For orders above **$500**, a signed affidavit of non-receipt is required before reshipment. Customer service agents and automated systems **may not waive the affidavit requirement**; it exists for fraud control. ---

chunks.heading: 7. Address Changes and Cancellation
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s13-c01] 7. Address Changes and Cancellation
## 7. Address Changes and Cancellation Orders may be modified or cancelled only before dispatch. Once an order has dispatched, it cannot be recalled, redirected, or cancelled, and the customer must use the returns process. Because most orders dispatch within hours, the practical window for a change is short. Agents should set this expectation explicitly rather than promising an attempt that will usually fail. ---

chunks.heading: 8. Peak Season
chunks.text:
[POL-SHP-007-s14-c01] 8. Peak Season
## 8. Peak Season Between **November 15 and December 26**, stated transit times are extended by 1–2 business days across all methods. Overnight service is suspended entirely from **December 20 through December 26**. Free shipping thresholds are unchanged during peak season.
